card.name: Small words before a predicted noun phrase
card.fires_on: Short function words such as "all", "files", "is" or "might" that come right after a subject noun or path, in SELinux command output and in disease-description text.

modes.label: SELinux path listing
modes.description: The word "all" or "files" after a /var/www or /srv/www path in semanage output.

modes.label: Verb after disorder or gene name
modes.description: The verb "is" or "might" after a disorder or gene name in a descriptive sentence.
modes.example: Because this disorder<< is>> variable in its expression, other organ systems

card.plain: It fires on small linking words in two unrelated settings: Linux file-policy listings and sentences describing a disorder or gene.
